Civic District

Civic District 6

  1. Must see · Civic District

    National Gallery Singapore

    World's largest public collection of Singapore & Southeast Asian art, in the former City Hall & Supreme Court.

    Look for Museum

    1 St Andrew's Road, Civic District

    Recommended by Visit Singapore (Singapore Tourism Board), Wikipedia (English)

  2. Must see · Cafés & Modern · Civic District

    Odette

    Three Michelin stars; Chef Julien Royer's flagship, a perennial Asia's 50 Best fixture.

    #01-04 National Gallery Singapore, 1 St Andrew's Road

    Recommended by MICHELIN Guide, HungryGoWhere

  3. Worth the detour · Civic District

    National Museum of Singapore

    The nation's oldest museum (est. 1849), narrating Singapore's social history.

    Look for Museum

    93 Stamford Road, Civic District

    Recommended by Wikipedia (English), Visit Singapore (Singapore Tourism Board)

  4. Worth the detour · Civic District

    Asian Civilisations Museum

    Riverside museum devoted to the material cultures of Asia, from Chinese to West Asian civilisations.

    Look for Museum

    1 Empress Place, Civic District

    Recommended by Wikipedia (English), Roots.gov.sg (National Heritage Board)

  5. Worth the detour · Civic District

    Raffles Hotel

    1887 colonial-era grande dame; a National Monument and birthplace of the Singapore Sling.

    Look for Heritage

    1 Beach Road, Civic District

    Recommended by Visit Singapore (Singapore Tourism Board), Wikipedia (English)

  6. Worth the detour · Civic District

    Fort Canning Park

    Historic hilltop park with artefacts dating to the 1300s; the famous Fort Canning tree tunnel.

    Look for Park

    River Valley Road, Fort Canning

    Recommended by NParks (National Parks Board), Roots.gov.sg (National Heritage Board)
